author: bardic-inspiration
name: Scroll of Third-Hour Rain
summary: A scroll that casts a storm over a small area.
description: The paper is damp and the ink runs, but the words stay legible. It rains on the owner at inconvenient times.

stats.effect: This scroll bears the *Call Lightning* spell. Using an action to read it casts the spell once at 3rd level, using DC 15 for its saving throw, and the scroll is consumed.
